newsitem.title: CHINA: China May interest rate subsidy zero percent.
newsitem.headline: China May interest rate subsidy zero percent.

text.p: China's central bank, the People's Bank of China, has set the May interest rate subsidy at zero percent, the Financial News said on Thursday.
The rate was 0.17 percent in April and 0.94 percent in March.

In future, the central bank will not announce the interest rate subsidy if it was zero percent, the newspaper said. The rate of a certain month would be announced before the 15th of the previous month.
The subsidy is paid on new bank deposits of three years or more.
The subsidy, paid on fixed deposits as they fall due, was given on top of normal interest rates to attract long-term deposits during a period of high inflation.
But China's stopped paying subsidy on new deposits as of April last year because inflation has been esing.
The subsidy was introduced in March 1994 and hit a record of 13.24 percent in December of last year.
